race.comment: FROM THE BLOCK (4) led all the way and bolted in two back over this distance at Morphettville then ran well again last time but found a couple better when dropping back to 1100m. Has earned the big weight and he looks the testing material upon his return to 1200m. TIPTOP TORI (5) is a quality mare back from an 18-week spell. The highlight of last prep was a barnstorming win in the Listed Adelaide Guineas over the mile. Collected her maiden first-up last time in work over this distance so a big run while fresh over the sprint course is not unprecedented. SIR MYKA (8) had a five-week let-up and showed a glimpse of form last start when beaten just over two lengths over 1100m at Morphettville. Can build on that performance with the blinkers back on today. RICHE D'AMOUR (9) flashed home to grab third over 1100m at Morphettville last time. Loves racing here so must be respected. THREE RINGS (11) has won two from three here at 1200m - can improve on a modest first-up effort.
